svg.title: No-connect mark
svg.desc: No-connect mark, IEEE 315-1975 §3.1.12 context only; documented CAD-practice exception (KiCad, Altium, OrCAD pin-end X). Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (24,14), end (24,14).
